During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], '''this''' [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] advised high ranking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You have allowed unidentified ships to pass through our defenses. Send a fleet to investigate.|The stormtrooper, to a commander|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this stormtrooper served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. He often advised Imperial commanders, sending messages to them at the beginning of battles. It is possible that he served in the [[Assault on Thyferra]]. If so, he was able to reconstruct communications leading to a pirate base on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. Afterwords, he would have been given orders to interrogate the pirate leader.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Lets show these vagrants who rules this galaxy!|The stormtrooper|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War" />}}
The Stormtrooper had a very negative view of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], believing it to be nothing more than a group of scoundrels and dissidents. He also saw them as technologically inferior, going so far as to tell a commander to "send them crawling back into their holes". He had no qualms about using the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. He had some knowledge of tactics, although he generally advised simple-minded, imperial tactics.

==Behind the scenes==
This character appears in Empire at War, sending messages to the player (If he is imperial) at the beginning of tactical battles. He does not do this in story levels. He also appears in Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption, though he'll only be seen if the player chooses Imperial Galactic Conquest. His quotes are the same, so he often refers to the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] as rebels.
